I entered 99 "six"es into seedsigner and accessed this wallet - so this person didn't roll dice, they just pressed the number 6 ninety-nine times in December 2022. 

Then it looks like 2 other people made the same mistake in June and October 2023...I also found a lot of transactions in the Legacy derivation path - these were all stolen on the same day (Dec 17th) but the legacy were stolen about 14-17 hours later than Native Segwit Funds.
